papers.title: Update for Decisions, Not Freshness: Goal-Oriented Status Updating and Selective Offloading at the Network Edge
papers.abstract: In an edge--cloud collaborative edge-computing environment, an edge node (EN) must decide whether each user task should be executed locally, forwarded to a remote service (or cloud) node (SN), or rejected. The EN observes its local state directly but receives the SN state only through an intermittently refreshed cache. Status updating and task control therefore form an asynchronous closed loop under partial observability.
